WITH supplier_metrics AS ( SELECT l_suppkey, COUNT(*) AS total_lines, SUM(CASE WHEN l_receiptdate <= l_commitdate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS on_time, AVG(l_receiptdate - l_shipdate) AS avg_lead_days FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_suppkey ) SELECT s_suppkey, s_name, n_name AS nation, ROUND(100.0 * on_time / total_lines, 2) AS fill_rate_pct, ROUND(avg_lead_days, 2) AS avg_lead_days, ROUND( 100.0 * on_time / total_lines - avg_lead_days, 2 ) AS performance_index FROM supplier_metrics JOIN supplier ON l_suppkey = s_suppkey JOIN nation ON s_nationkey = n_nationkey ORDER BY performance_index DESC LIMIT 30;

WITH part_cost AS (SELECT p_partkey,p_name,p_brand,ps_suppkey,ps_supplycost,ps_availqty,ps_supplycost*ps_availqty AS weighted_cost FROM part JOIN partsupp ON p_partkey=ps_partkey) SELECT p_partkey,p_name,p_brand,SUM(weighted_cost)/NULLIF(SUM(ps_availqty),0) AS weighted_avg_cost FROM part_cost GROUP BY p_partkey,p_name,p_brand ORDER BY weighted_avg_cost DESC LIMIT 100;

WITH part_cost AS (SELECT p_partkey,p_brand,ps_supplycost,ps_availqty FROM part JOIN partsupp ON p_partkey=ps_partkey) SELECT p_brand,AVG(ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost,SUM(ps_availqty) AS total_inventory FROM part_cost GROUP BY p_brand ORDER BY avg_supply_cost DESC;

WITH part_cost AS (SELECT p_partkey,p_name,p_brand,ps_supplycost,ps_availqty FROM part JOIN partsupp ON p_partkey=ps_partkey) SELECT p_partkey,p_name,p_brand,MAX(ps_supplycost) AS max_cost,MIN(ps_supplycost) AS min_cost FROM part_cost GROUP BY p_partkey,p_name,p_brand ORDER BY max_cost DESC LIMIT 100;

WITH part_cost AS (SELECT p_partkey,p_name,p_brand,ps_suppkey,ps_supplycost,ps_availqty FROM part JOIN partsupp ON p_partkey=ps_partkey) SELECT p_brand,COUNT(DISTINCT p_partkey) AS part_count,COUNT(DISTINCT ps_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM part_cost GROUP BY p_brand ORDER BY supplier_count DESC;

WITH weighted_avg AS (SELECT p_partkey,p_name,p_brand,SUM(ps_supplycost*ps_availqty)/NULLIF(SUM(ps_availqty),0) AS weighted_avg_cost FROM part JOIN partsupp ON p_partkey=ps_partkey GROUP BY p_partkey,p_name,p_brand) SELECT *,DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY weighted_avg_cost DESC) AS overall_rank FROM weighted_avg LIMIT 100;

WITH weighted_avg AS (SELECT p_partkey,p_name,p_brand,SUM(ps_supplycost*ps_availqty)/NULLIF(SUM(ps_availqty),0) AS weighted_avg_cost FROM part JOIN partsupp ON p_partkey=ps_partkey WHERE ps_availqty>500 GROUP BY p_partkey,p_name,p_brand) SELECT * FROM weighted_avg ORDER BY weighted_avg_cost DESC LIMIT 100;

WITH weighted_avg AS (SELECT p_partkey,p_name,p_brand,SUM(ps_supplycost*ps_availqty)/NULLIF(SUM(ps_availqty),0) AS weighted_avg_cost,SUM(ps_availqty) AS total_avail FROM part JOIN partsupp ON p_partkey=ps_partkey GROUP BY p_partkey,p_name,p_brand) SELECT * FROM weighted_avg WHERE total_avail>(SELECT AVG(ps_availqty) FROM partsupp) ORDER BY weighted_avg_cost DESC;

WITH supplier_stats AS (SELECT p_partkey,p_name,p_brand,COUNT(ps_suppkey) AS supplier_count,AVG(ps_supplycost) AS avg_cost FROM part JOIN partsupp ON p_partkey=ps_partkey GROUP BY p_partkey,p_name,p_brand) SELECT *,RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p_brand ORDER BY supplier_count DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier_stats ORDER BY p_brand,supplier_rank;

WITH weighted_avg AS (SELECT p_partkey,p_name,p_brand,SUM(ps_supplycost*ps_availqty)/NULLIF(SUM(ps_availqty),0) AS weighted_avg_cost,COUNT(ps_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM part JOIN partsupp ON p_partkey=ps_partkey GROUP BY p_partkey,p_name,p_brand) SELECT *,NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY weighted_avg_cost DESC) AS cost_quartile FROM weighted_avg ORDER BY cost_quartile,weighted_avg_cost DESC;

WITH customer_spend AS ( SELECT c_custkey, c_name, n_regionkey, SUM(o_totalprice) AS total_spend FROM customer JOIN nation ON c_nationkey = n_nationkey JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey GROUP BY c_custkey, c_name, n_regionkey ), regional_threshold AS ( SELECT n_regionkey, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.90) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total_spend) AS p90_spend FROM customer_spend GROUP BY n_regionkey ) SELECT cs.*, r_name FROM customer_spend cs JOIN regional_threshold rt ON cs.n_regionkey = rt.n_regionkey JOIN region ON cs.n_regionkey = r_regionkey WHERE cs.total_spend >= rt.p90_spend ORDER BY r_name, total_spend DESC;

WITH first_order AS (SELECT o_custkey,EXTRACT(YEAR FROM MIN(o_orderdate)) AS cohort_year FROM orders GROUP BY o_custkey),activity AS (SELECT o.o_custkey,fo.cohort_year,EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) AS activity_year,o.o_totalprice FROM orders o JOIN first_order fo ON o.o_custkey=fo.o_custkey) SELECT cohort_year,activity_year,AVG(o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value,COUNT(DISTINCT o_custkey) AS customers FROM activity GROUP BY cohort_year,activity_year ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC;

WITH part_type_supply AS ( SELECT p_type, ps_suppkey, SUM(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) AS supply_value FROM part JOIN partsupp ON p_partkey = ps_partkey GROUP BY p_type, ps_suppkey ), total_by_type AS ( SELECT p_type, SUM(supply_value) AS type_total FROM part_type_supply GROUP BY p_type ), herfindahl AS ( SELECT pts.p_type, SUM(POWER(pts.supply_value / tbt.type_total, 2)) AS hhi FROM part_type_supply pts JOIN total_by_type tbt ON pts.p_type = tbt.p_type GROUP BY pts.p_type ) SELECT p_type, ROUND(hhi::NUMERIC, 6) AS hhi_score, CASE WHEN hhi > 0.25 THEN 'High Concentration' WHEN hhi > 0.15 THEN 'Moderate Concentration' ELSE 'Competitive' END AS market_structure FROM herfindahl ORDER BY hhi_score DESC;
